response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned, versatile engineer with 15+ years of experience, a CS degree, and credible depth in backend, high-throughput services (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby), testing craftsmanship, and developer tooling — all of which satisfy the generic engineering bar. However, the role is highly domain-specific: growth engineering, experimentation/A-B testing platforms, feature flighting, telemetry and metrics infrastructure, and statistical analysis. The resume shows essentially no evidence of experimentation systems, measurement platforms, guardrail metrics, or data/statistical work, and no demonstrated principal-level scope influencing multiple teams or products in an enterprise setting. Recent work has been at small companies with narrower blast radius than IC6 expects.
strengths: 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency distributed backends
Proven high-scale service experience (millions of HTTP req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong craftsmanship, testing/TDD, OSS authorship, and teaching/mentoring track record
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging platform experience
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis aptitude
Scope and titles (Senior/Staff at small firms) below Principal/IC6 cross-org expectations

key_factors.factor: Insufficient evidence of principal-level, multi-team scope
Deep, broad engineering fundamentals and high-throughput systems work
